title: Implicit requirement to call allow_loopback_for_tests() not documented
description:
File: crates/kithd/src/lib.rs lines 11-19, tests/peer_attachment_fetch.rs line 162

The allow_loopback_for_tests() function must be called before any test that uses fetch_peer_blob on loopback addresses. This requirement is implicit and not documented.

Current behavior:
- Unit tests in peer_fetch.rs use fetch_peer_blob_from_url (test helper) which skips SSRF checks
- Integration test in tests/peer_attachment_fetch.rs correctly calls allow_loopback_for_tests()
- But there is no inline comment or rustdoc warning about this requirement

Risk: A future developer adding an integration test that calls fetch_peer_blob directly on loopback might forget to call allow_loopback_for_tests() and see 'HostRejected' errors.

Fix: Add rustdoc to allow_loopback_for_tests() explaining when and why to call it.
